m: You pay to **defend** yourself against **danger**: that is **insurance**.
ex: 你买保险了吗？
Have you bought insurance?
这辆车的保险明年三月到期。
The insurance on this car runs out next March.
use: Measure word 份. 买保险 "buy insurance"; 保险公司 "insurance company". As an adjective it can mean "safe".

m: What you **learn** earns you a **position** on paper: an **academic degree**.
ex: 她在美国拿到了博士学位。
She got her doctorate in the USA.
有了这个学位，他找工作容易多了。
With this degree, finding a job was much easier for him.
use: Used with 拿到 or 获得 "obtain": 硕士学位 master's, 博士学位 doctorate.

m: A **finger** **shows** the way: to **point out** or **indicate**, and also an instruction.
ex: 请按照老师的指示去做。
Please do as the teacher instructs.
地图上的箭头指示了出口的方向。
The arrow on the map indicates the way to the exit.
use: As a noun it often means an order from a superior: 上级的指示.

m: The land of a **king**, the **country** he rules: a **kingdom**.
ex: 这个王国有三百年的历史。
This kingdom has a history of three hundred years.
童话里的小王国住着一位美丽的公主。
In the fairy tale, a beautiful princess lived in a small kingdom.
use: Also used figuratively: 动物王国 "the animal kingdom".

ex: 我对这次考试很有信心。
I'm very confident about this exam.
别失去信心，你一定能做到。
Don't lose heart; you can definitely do it.
use: Goes with 有, 没有, 失去 "lose" and 对…有信心 "be confident about…".

m: The **capacity** you have **stored up** underground: **reserves** of oil, coal and so on.
ex: 这里的石油储量很大。
The oil reserves here are very large.
专家说这个地区的煤炭储量还能开采一百年。
Experts say the coal reserves in this region can be mined for another hundred years.
use: Used for natural resources: 石油储量, 天然气储量, 水资源储量.

ex: 她高兴得流下了眼泪。
She was so happy she shed tears.
孩子擦干眼泪，又笑了起来。
The child wiped away his tears and began to smile again.
use: Measure word 滴 (a drop). 流眼泪 "shed tears".

m: What you **want** most, as basic as **raw silk** is to cloth: an **essential factor**.
ex: 时间是成功的重要要素之一。
Time is one of the key factors in success.
一篇好文章有几个基本要素。
A good essay has a few basic elements.
use: Fairly formal; in speech 因素 or 关键 is more common.

m: **Russia**: 俄 is short for Russia, plus **country**. A place name.
ex: 他年轻时在俄国住过两年。
He lived in Russia for two years when he was young.
这本小说是一位俄国作家写的。
This novel was written by a Russian writer.
use: Older name for Russia; today 俄罗斯 is the usual name.

m: **Transfer** a little at each **joint** until it is right: to **adjust** or **regulate**.
ex: 这个空调可以调节温度。
This air conditioner can adjust the temperature.
运动能帮助我们调节心情。
Exercise can help us regulate our mood.
use: Used with 温度, 心情, 气氛 and 市场; compare 调整, which is broader "readjust".

m: How **feelings** **appear** on the outside: the **circumstances** or **situation**.
ex: 当时的情形非常危险。
The situation at the time was very dangerous.
我还记得第一次见面时的情形。
I still remember how things were when we first met.
use: Close to 情况, but 情形 is more about how a scene looks.

m: What you **feel** and **receive** from the world: to **sense**, a **perception** or experience.
ex: 说说你这次旅行的感受吧。
Tell us how you felt about this trip.
我能感受到大家对我的关心。
I can feel everyone's care for me.
use: As a noun, often with 有, 谈 or 说: 我有很深的感受.

m: The **gas** and **miasma** that hangs in a room: its **atmosphere** or **mood**.
ex: 晚会的气氛非常热闹。
The party had a very lively atmosphere.
他一说话，房间里的气氛就紧张起来了。
As soon as he spoke, the mood in the room became tense.
use: Used for people's mood, not the earth's air (大气).

ex: 请深呼吸，放松一点。
Take a deep breath and relax a bit.
山上空气很好，呼吸起来特别舒服。
The air on the mountain is good; it feels great to breathe.
use: 深呼吸 "deep breath"; 呼吸新鲜空气 "breathe fresh air".

m: **Half** a **day**, and in speech, **a long time**.
ex: 我等了你半天了！
I've been waiting for you for ages!
我们上午去公园玩了半天。
We spent the morning in the park.
use: In speech it usually means "a long time", not exactly half a day.

m: **Plum**, **wild goose**, **chapter**: the name of **Li Hongzhang**, a Qing dynasty statesman.
ex: 李鸿章是清朝的大臣。
Li Hongzhang was a minister of the Qing dynasty.
历史课上，老师讲了李鸿章的故事。
In history class, the teacher told the story of Li Hongzhang.
use: A famous late-Qing official (1823–1901), linked with treaties and modernisation.

ex: 这座桥是去年修建的。
This bridge was built last year.
政府打算在这里修建一个新机场。
The government plans to build a new airport here.
use: Used for roads, bridges, buildings; 盖 is more spoken for houses.

ex: 这家商店供应新鲜水果。
This shop supplies fresh fruit.
夏天用电多，电力供应有点紧张。
Summer uses a lot of power, so the electricity supply gets tight.
use: Often with 水, 电, 食品: 供应充足 "ample supply".

m: Carrying the **shoulder pole** into a **fight**: a **challenge**, or to **challenge**.
ex: 这份工作对我来说是一个挑战。
This job is a challenge for me.
他决定挑战自己，去跑一次马拉松。
He decided to challenge himself and run a marathon.
use: 面对挑战 "face a challenge"; 接受挑战 "accept a challenge".

ex: 这座城市以钢铁工业出名。
This city is famous for its steel industry.
他有钢铁一样的意志。
He has a will of steel.
use: Also used figuratively for strength: 钢铁般的 "steely".

ex: 这种气体没有颜色，也没有味道。
This gas has no colour and no smell.
汽车排出的气体会污染空气。
The gas cars give off pollutes the air.
use: 气体 is the science word; 气 alone is everyday "air/gas".

m: **Form** parts and **close** them together: to **combine**, a combination.
ex: 这两种颜色组合在一起很好看。
These two colours look nice together.
他们三个人组成了一个音乐组合。
The three of them formed a music group.
use: As a noun it can mean a band or group: 音乐组合.

ex: 这是一个关于爱情的故事。
This is a story about love.
他们的爱情经历了很多考验。
Their love went through many trials.
use: Only romantic love; for love of family use 爱 or 亲情.

m: The **self** is the **owner**: to **act independently**, to be **autonomous**.
ex: 孩子应该学会自主学习。
Children should learn to study on their own.
这家公司有自主开发新产品的能力。
This company can develop new products by itself.
use: Often 自主学习, 自主选择, 独立自主.

m: As thin as **silk**, as fine as a **hair**: **the slightest bit**.
ex: 他丝毫没有感到害怕。
He didn't feel the least bit afraid.
这件事对我们丝毫没有影响。
This has no effect on us at all.
use: Almost always in negatives: 丝毫不 / 丝毫没有 "not in the least".

m: **Overtake** time and hold it **tight**: **hurry**, without delay.
ex: 快下雨了，我们赶紧回家吧。
It's about to rain, let's hurry home.
他听到消息，赶紧给妈妈打了电话。
When he heard the news, he quickly phoned his mother.
use: Spoken; goes before a verb. Similar to 赶快 and 连忙.

ex: 这里是沙漠地带，很少下雨。
This is a desert zone; it rarely rains.
山区和平原之间有一片过渡地带。
There is a transition zone between the mountains and the plain.
use: Used for geography and areas: 危险地带, 安全地带.

m: **Press against** and **touch** in a clash: to **conflict** or **contradict**.
ex: 这两条规定互相抵触。
These two rules contradict each other.
他对新的工作安排有点抵触。
He's a bit resistant to the new work arrangements.
use: Also means emotional resistance: 抵触情绪 "resentment".

m: **Carry** someone out of sleep so they **wake up**: to **remind**.
ex: 请提醒我明天带护照。
Please remind me to bring my passport tomorrow.
妈妈总是提醒我出门要带伞。
Mum always reminds me to take an umbrella when I go out.
use: Pattern: 提醒某人做某事 "remind someone to do something".

ex: 有紧急情况请打这个电话。
In an emergency, call this number.
飞机上的乘客都知道紧急出口在哪里吗？
Do all the passengers know where the emergency exits are?
use: 紧急情况 "emergency"; 紧急出口 "emergency exit".

m: Let news **penetrate** like **dew** seeping through: to **leak** or **reveal**.
ex: 他不愿意透露自己的年龄。
He doesn't want to reveal his age.
公司还没有透露新手机的价格。
The company hasn't disclosed the price of the new phone yet.
use: For telling something hidden or private; 告诉 is the neutral word.

m: **Take part in** and **check** others' work: to **consult**, a **reference**.
ex: 这本书可以作为参考。
This book can be used as a reference.
写报告时，我参考了很多资料。
When I wrote the report, I consulted a lot of materials.
use: 参考书 "reference book"; 仅供参考 "for reference only".

m: The **west** where treasures are **concealed**: **Tibet**, a place name.
ex: 我很想去西藏旅游。
I'd love to travel to Tibet.
西藏的天特别蓝，山特别高。
In Tibet the sky is very blue and the mountains are very high.
use: Here 藏 is read zàng, "treasure store"; 藏族 is the Tibetan people.

ex: 佛教是从印度传到中国的。
Buddhism came to China from India.
她的奶奶信佛教，常去寺庙。
Her grandmother is a Buddhist and often goes to the temple.
use: 信佛教 "believe in Buddhism"; a Buddhist is 佛教徒.

ex: 我的老家在江西。
My hometown is in Jiangxi.
江西有很多好看的山和湖。
Jiangxi has many beautiful mountains and lakes.
use: Province name; its short name is 赣.

m: **Cave**, **hall**, **lake**: **Dongting Lake**, a large lake in Hunan.
ex: 洞庭湖在湖南省。
Dongting Lake is in Hunan Province.
夏天的洞庭湖水面很大，非常美丽。
In summer Dongting Lake is very wide and beautiful.
use: One of China's largest freshwater lakes; 湖南 means "south of the lake".

ex: 请坐下，我们开始上课。
Please sit down; let's start class.
他走进房间，在我旁边坐下了。
He came into the room and sat down beside me.
use: Compare 坐 "sit / be sitting"; 坐下 is the action of sitting down.

ex: 医生给他测量了体温。
The doctor took his temperature.
工人正在测量这块地的面积。
The workers are measuring the area of this plot.
use: More formal than 量; used for 体温, 距离, 面积.

m: The **rule** by which things **go forward**: a **process** or course of events.
ex: 这件事加快了改革的进程。
This sped up the process of reform.
电脑上同时运行着很多进程。
Many processes are running on the computer at once.
use: Fairly formal; also the computing word for a running "process".

ex: 这条路一直延伸到海边。
This road stretches all the way to the coast.
这个话题还可以继续延伸下去。
This topic can be taken further.
use: Used for roads, lines and ideas; 延长 is about length of time.

ex: 文化大革命从一九六六年开始。
The Cultural Revolution began in 1966.
我爷爷在文化大革命时期去了农村。
My grandfather went to the countryside during the Cultural Revolution.
use: Often shortened to 文革.

ex: 我们班有十五个学生。
There are fifteen students in our class.
今天是农历八月十五，也就是中秋节。
Today is the 15th of the eighth lunar month, the Mid-Autumn Festival.
use: 十五 also names the 15th of a lunar month.

m: The **hot** **band** around the earth's middle: the **tropics**.
ex: 这种水果只长在热带。
This fruit only grows in the tropics.
海南岛属于热带气候，冬天也很暖和。
Hainan Island has a tropical climate; it's warm even in winter.
use: 热带水果 "tropical fruit"; 热带雨林 "tropical rainforest".

ex: 这辆车的发动机坏了。
This car's engine has broken down.
飞机的发动机声音很大。
Aircraft engines are very loud.
use: Measure word 台. 引擎 is a loanword for the same thing.

ex: 这里禁止吸烟。
Smoking is forbidden here.
学校禁止学生在上课时用手机。
The school forbids students to use phones in class.
use: Common on signs: 禁止停车 "no parking". Stronger than 不要.

m: **Continue** and **bear** what comes down to you: to **inherit**.
ex: 他继承了父亲的公司。
He inherited his father's company.
我们应该继承和发扬优秀的传统。
We should carry on and develop fine traditions.
use: For property, thrones, and traditions; 遗传 is genetic inheritance.

ex: 他的回答简单而有力。
His answer was short and forceful.
这些数据是最有力的证据。
These figures are the strongest evidence.
use: Often 强而有力; also 有力地 "forcefully".

ex: 第二天早上，雨停了。
The next morning, the rain stopped.
我们到北京的第二天就去了长城。
The day after we arrived in Beijing, we went to the Great Wall.
use: For the next day in a past story; for "tomorrow" from now use 明天.

m: The **neck** and **sleeves** of a robe stand out first: a **leader**.
ex: 他是一位伟大的领袖。
He was a great leader.
这个国家的领袖今天访问了中国。
The leader of this country visited China today.
use: For leaders of nations or movements; 领导 is the everyday "boss".

ex: 西安是一座很古老的城市。
Xi'an is a very old city.
很多人去西安是为了看兵马俑。
Many people go to Xi'an to see the Terracotta Warriors.
use: Capital of Shaanxi; once called 长安.

m: **Follow** a **ring** round and round: to **cycle** or **circulate**.
ex: 这首歌我循环听了一下午。
I listened to this song on repeat all afternoon.
运动可以促进血液循环。
Exercise can improve blood circulation.
use: 血液循环 "blood circulation"; 恶性循环 "vicious circle".

ex: 听到这个好消息，大家都很兴奋。
Everyone was excited to hear the good news.
孩子们兴奋得睡不着觉。
The children were too excited to sleep.
use: Describes a person's state; for an exciting thing use 激动人心 or 精彩.

m: A **home** built on **resources** and their **root**, capital: a **capitalist**.
ex: 他的爷爷是个资本家。
His grandfather was a capitalist.
这部电影讲的是一个资本家的故事。
This film tells the story of a capitalist.
use: Made of 资本 "capital" + 家 "person who does it".

ex: 武昌区在长江的南岸。
Wuchang District is on the south bank of the Yangtze.
我们的大学就在武昌区。
Our university is in Wuchang District.
use: One of the old three towns of Wuhan, with 汉口 and 汉阳.

m: A **matter** listed under its own heading: an **item** or matter.
ex: 请注意以下几个事项。
Please note the following points.
出发前，导游说了旅行的注意事项。
Before we left, the guide went over things to watch out for on the trip.
use: Formal; 注意事项 "points to note" is the commonest use.

m: Join two **ditches** so water **goes through**: to **communicate**, to connect.
ex: 父母应该多和孩子沟通。
Parents should communicate more with their children.
我们之间的沟通出了一点问题。
There's been a bit of a problem in communication between us.
use: Pattern 和/跟某人沟通; about mutual understanding, not just talking.

m: The **era** **near** to ours: **modern times** (in China, about 1840–1919).
ex: 这本书讲的是中国近代史。
This book is about China's modern history.
近代以来，这座城市发生了很大的变化。
Since modern times, this city has changed a great deal.
use: 近代 is earlier than 现代 and 当代 in Chinese history terms.

m: The **first** stage of **middle** school: **junior high school**.
ex: 我弟弟今年上初中了。
My younger brother started junior high this year.
我们是初中同学，认识十几年了。
We were classmates in junior high; we've known each other over ten years.
use: Short for 初级中学; senior high is 高中.

m: Show on the **surface** what you **decide**: to **vote**.
ex: 大家举手表决吧。
Let's vote by a show of hands.
这个计划在会上表决通过了。
The plan was passed by vote at the meeting.
use: Formal; 投票 is "cast a ballot".

ex: 这里的人对我们很友好。
The people here are very friendly to us.
两国一直保持着友好关系。
The two countries have always kept friendly relations.
use: Pattern 对…友好; also 友好城市 "sister city".

m: You **can** **see** it: so **it is clear that**...
ex: 他每天都来，可见他很喜欢这里。
He comes every day, which shows he really likes it here.
成绩提高了这么多，可见你很努力。
Your grades went up so much; clearly you worked hard.
use: Starts a conclusion drawn from what was just said.

m: Characters used for sound: **Greece**, a country name.
ex: 希腊有很多古老的建筑。
Greece has many ancient buildings.
我们去年夏天去了希腊旅游。
We went on holiday to Greece last summer.
use: 希腊语 "Greek (language)"; 希腊人 "a Greek".

ex: 全班学生的总数是四十人。
There are forty students in the class in total.
今年来这里的游客总数超过了一百万。
The total number of tourists here this year passed one million.
use: Used with 达到 or 超过; compare 总共, an adverb "altogether".

ex: 我们的时间足够了。
We have enough time.
只要有足够的钱，他就想去环游世界。
As long as he has enough money, he wants to travel the world.
use: Can go before a noun with 的: 足够的时间.

ex: 这个工作需要男性。
This job needs a man.
调查显示，男性比女性更喜欢运动。
The survey shows men like sport more than women.
use: Formal and neutral; 男人 is the everyday word.

ex: 感冒是一种常见的病。
A cold is a common illness.
这种花在南方很常见。
This flower is very common in the south.
use: 常见问题 "frequently asked questions".

ex: 水有三种形态。
Water has three forms.
这些云的形态各不相同。
These clouds all have different shapes.
use: More scientific than 样子 or 形状.

ex: 你有什么想法？
What do you think?
我有一个好想法，我们周末去爬山吧。
I've got a good idea: let's go climbing this weekend.
use: Very common in speech; 看法 is more "view on something".

ex: 这部电影还在后期制作中。
This film is still in post-production.
清朝后期，社会问题越来越多。
In the late Qing dynasty, social problems kept growing.
use: Opposite of 前期 "early stage"; 中期 "middle stage".

ex: 听了他的话，大家无不感动。
Everyone was moved by what he said.
看过这部电影的人无不说好。
Everyone who has seen this film says it's good.
use: Written style; a double negative meaning "every single one".

ex: 校长在大会上讲话。
The headmaster gave a speech at the assembly.
上课的时候不要讲话。
Don't talk in class.
use: As a noun it is a formal speech; 说话 is the everyday "talk".

ex: 这座桥连接了两个城市。
This bridge connects the two cities.
我的手机连接不上网络。
My phone can't connect to the network.
use: Used for things, networks and devices: 连接无线网.

ex: 这个停车场收费吗？
Does this car park charge?
博物馆周一不收费，大家都可以进去。
The museum is free on Mondays; everyone can go in.
use: 免费 is the opposite "free of charge".

m: **Bring up** a topic until it **reaches** the talk: to **mention**.
ex: 他在信里提到了你。
He mentioned you in his letter.
刚才你提到的那家饭馆在哪儿？
Where is that restaurant you just mentioned?
use: Takes an object directly: 提到这件事.

ex: 我差不多做完了。
I'm almost done.
这两件衣服的颜色差不多，你随便选一件吧。
These two shirts are almost the same colour; just pick one.
use: As adverb "nearly"; as adjective "similar" or "good enough".

m: **Cut off** and **stop**: to **close**, to end (a deadline).
ex: 报名明天截止。
Registration closes tomorrow.
这份作业的截止日期是下周五。
The deadline for this assignment is next Friday.
use: 截止日期 "deadline". Compare 截至 "up to (a date)".

ex: 感冒的症状有发烧和咳嗽。
Symptoms of a cold include fever and coughing.
如果症状没有好转，请再来医院。
If the symptoms don't improve, please come back to the hospital.
use: Medical word; often 出现症状 "symptoms appear".

m: **Wu** (a surname), **three**, **cassia tree**: **Wu Sangui**, a late Ming general.
ex: 吴三桂是明朝末年的将军。
Wu Sangui was a general at the end of the Ming dynasty.
很多人都知道吴三桂打开山海关的故事。
Many people know the story of Wu Sangui opening the Shanhai Pass.
use: Remembered for letting the Manchu army through the Great Wall in 1644.

m: **Record** it so you **get** it back: to **remember**.
ex: 你还记得我吗？
Do you still remember me?
记得出门的时候关好窗户。
Remember to shut the windows when you go out.
use: 记得 is "remember"; 记住 is "commit to memory".

m: **Check** and **examine**: to **inspect**, and in law, to **prosecute**.
ex: 他在检察机关工作。
He works for the prosecutor's office.
这个案件已经交给检察院处理了。
This case has been handed over to the procuratorate.
use: Legal word; 检查 is the everyday "check".

ex: 东京是日本的首都。
Tokyo is the capital of Japan.
我下个月要去东京出差。
I'm going to Tokyo on business next month.
use: Historically 东京 also named Kaifeng in the Song dynasty.

m: **Promulgate** and **announce**: to **issue** a law or rule.
ex: 政府颁布了新的法律。
The government issued a new law.
这项规定是去年颁布的，今年开始实行。
This regulation was issued last year and took effect this year.
use: Formal; used with 法律, 规定, 命令.

ex: 这家公司专门研究高新技术。
This company specialises in high technology.
城市东边有一个高新技术开发区。
There's a high-tech development zone on the east side of town.
use: Often in 高新技术产业 "high-tech industry"; shortened to 高新.

ex: 我去过北京几次。
I've been to Beijing a few times.
你一个星期运动几次？
How many times a week do you exercise?
use: In a question it asks "how many times"; in a statement it means "a few times".

m: **Detailed** down to the **slender** points: **detailed**, in detail.
ex: 请详细说一下你的计划。
Please explain your plan in detail.
这本书对历史的介绍非常详细。
This book's account of history is very detailed.
use: Before a verb: 详细地介绍; opposite of 简单.

m: **Go** to the **front**: to **leave for** or **head to**.
ex: 代表团明天前往上海。
The delegation leaves for Shanghai tomorrow.
乘客请到三号门前往登机。
Passengers, please go to Gate 3 to board.
use: Formal; in speech use 去.

ex: 我们下午五点返回学校。
We return to school at five in the afternoon.
飞机因为天气不好，返回了北京。
Because of bad weather, the plane went back to Beijing.
use: Formal; in speech 回去 or 回来. Also the "Back" button in apps.

ex: 司法应该独立公正。
The judiciary should be independent and fair.
这是一个司法问题，需要法院来决定。
This is a judicial matter; the court must decide it.
use: Formal; often 司法机关 "judicial bodies".

ex: 政府大力发展旅游业。
The government is vigorously developing tourism.
我们要大力支持年轻人创业。
We should strongly support young people starting businesses.
use: Goes before verbs like 发展, 支持, 推广.

ex: 这家店提供优质的服务。
This shop offers excellent service.
这里出产的大米是优质大米。
The rice produced here is top-quality rice.
use: Mostly written, in ads and reports: 优质产品.

ex: 我怀疑他没说真话。
I suspect he didn't tell the truth.
你不要怀疑自己的能力。
Don't doubt your own ability.
use: Careful: 我怀疑他是小偷 means "I suspect he is the thief".

ex: 天上飞过两架战斗机。
Two fighter jets flew overhead.
这种新型战斗机速度非常快。
This new type of fighter is extremely fast.
use: Measure word 架.

ex: 他是这个国家的开国总统。
He was the founding president of this country.
开国大典在一九四九年十月一日举行。
The founding ceremony was held on 1 October 1949.
use: Mostly in set phrases: 开国元勋 "founding father", 开国大典.

ex: 我们住在市中心的一家酒店。
We're staying at a hotel in the city centre.
这家酒店的早餐很不错。
The breakfast at this hotel is very good.
use: Measure word 家. Today it usually means "hotel", like 饭店 and 宾馆.

ex: 与其在家等，不如出去找找。
Rather than waiting at home, we'd better go and look.
与其抱怨，不如想办法解决问题。
Rather than complaining, find a way to solve the problem.
use: Pattern 与其A，不如B "B is better than A".

ex: 她的性格很开朗。
She has a cheerful personality.
他们俩性格不同，但是关系很好。
They have different personalities but get on very well.
use: 性格好 "good-natured"; 个性 is more "individuality".

ex: 这部影片得了很多奖。
This film has won many awards.
今晚电视上播放一部老影片。
An old film is on TV tonight.
use: Measure word 部. More formal than 电影.

ex: 我的中文不如你。
My Chinese isn't as good as yours.
外面这么冷，我们不如在家看电影吧。
It's so cold out; we'd better watch a film at home.
use: A 不如 B "A is not as good as B"; also "might as well".

ex: 大批游客来到这里。
Large numbers of tourists came here.
节日前，商店进了大批商品。
Before the holiday, the shop stocked large quantities of goods.
use: Goes before nouns of people or goods; 大量 is broader.

ex: 祝你生日快乐！
Happy birthday!
和朋友在一起的时候，我很快乐。
I'm happy when I'm with friends.
use: Used in greetings: 新年快乐. 高兴 is more about a moment's mood.

ex: 我的手指受伤了。
I hurt my finger.
他用手指在桌子上画了一个圆。
He drew a circle on the table with his finger.
use: Measure word 根. 脚指 / 脚趾 is "toe".

m: The one in **charge** who gives the **orders**: a **commanding officer**.
ex: 他是这支部队的司令。
He is the commander of this army.
司令下令马上出发。
The commander ordered them to set out at once.
use: Military rank; 司令部 is "headquarters".

ex: 他最近被提升为经理。
He was recently promoted to manager.
多读书可以提升自己的能力。
Reading more can improve your abilities.
use: For jobs (提升为…) and for levels: 提升水平, 提升质量.

ex: 今年的粮食总量增加了。
Total grain output rose this year.
这个国家的经济总量排在世界前列。
This country's total economy ranks among the world's top.
use: Formal, in economics and statistics.

m: The **head** of the pier where goods are **weighed**: a **wharf** or **dock**.
ex: 船慢慢靠近了码头。
The boat slowly came up to the dock.
我们在码头等了半天，船才来。
We waited at the pier for ages before the boat came.
use: Measure word 个 or 座.

ex: 这台机器的构造很简单。
This machine has a simple structure.
医生给我们讲了人体的构造。
The doctor explained the structure of the human body to us.
use: Physical structure; 结构 is broader, also for ideas and texts.

ex: 总体来说，这次考试不太难。
Overall, this exam wasn't too hard.
我们的总体目标是提高服务质量。
Our overall goal is to improve service quality.
use: Common phrase: 总体来说 / 总体上 "on the whole".

m: The **highest** **people's** **court** of **law**: the **Supreme People's Court** of China.
ex: 最高人民法院在北京。
The Supreme People's Court is in Beijing.
这个案子最后由最高人民法院决定。
In the end this case was decided by the Supreme People's Court.
use: Shortened to 最高法. Each place also has 中级/高级人民法院.

m: A **place** used for a purpose: a **location** or **venue**.
ex: 公共场所不能吸烟。
Smoking isn't allowed in public places.
图书馆是一个安静学习的好场所。
A library is a good place for quiet study.
use: Formal; 公共场所 "public place", 娱乐场所 "place of entertainment".

ex: 我常常在网上买东西。
I often shop online.
这个消息网上已经有很多人在讨论了。
Lots of people are already discussing this news online.
use: Comes before verbs (网上购物) or after 在 (在网上).

m: **Vermilion**, **first**, **jade tablet**: **Zhu Yuanzhang**, founder of the Ming dynasty.
ex: 朱元璋是明朝的第一个皇帝。
Zhu Yuanzhang was the first emperor of the Ming dynasty.
朱元璋小时候家里很穷，还当过和尚。
Zhu Yuanzhang's family was poor when he was young, and he was even a monk.
use: Reigned 1368–1398 as the Hongwu Emperor.

m: The **way** you **look** at it: a **view** or **opinion**.
ex: 你对这件事有什么看法？
What's your view on this?
我们的看法不一样，但可以互相学习。
Our views differ, but we can learn from each other.
use: Pattern 对…的看法; close to 想法 "idea".

m: The space **between** walls in a **house**: a **room**.
ex: 我的房间很小。
My room is very small.
酒店还有空房间吗？
Does the hotel still have any free rooms?
use: Measure word 个 or 间.

ex: 他对音乐毫无兴趣。
He has no interest at all in music.
这样做毫无意义。
Doing it like this is completely pointless.
use: Followed by a noun: 毫无办法, 毫无疑问 "without a doubt".

m: **Obey** and **rule**: **Shunzhi**, reign name of the first Qing emperor in Beijing.
ex: 顺治是清朝入关后的第一个皇帝。
Shunzhi was the first Qing emperor to rule from inside the Great Wall.
顺治皇帝六岁就当上了皇帝。
The Shunzhi Emperor came to the throne at the age of six.
use: Reign 1644–1661; followed by 康熙.

ex: 房间里一片黑暗。
The room was in total darkness.
有的孩子害怕黑暗，晚上要开着灯。
Some children are afraid of the dark and need the light on at night.
use: Also figurative: 黑暗的社会 "a dark society". 黑 alone is plainer.

m: An **office** and its **position**: a **post** or job.
ex: 公司现在有几个空职位。
The company has a few open positions now.
他在银行担任很高的职位。
He holds a high position at the bank.
use: Formal; 工作 is the everyday "job".

ex: 这一带都是丘陵。
This whole area is hills.
江南有很多低矮的丘陵。
South of the Yangtze there are many low hills.
use: Geography word for rolling hill country, between 平原 and 山区.

ex: 自从来了中国，我每天都说汉语。
Since coming to China, I speak Chinese every day.
自从那次以后，我们再也没见过面。
Since that time, we have never met again.
use: Only for the past: 自从…以后/以来. Not for "because".

ex: 有问题随时问我。
Ask me any time you have a question.
天气不好，飞机随时可能晚点。
The weather's bad; the flight could be delayed at any time.
use: Spoken and common: 随时欢迎 "welcome any time".

ex: 我喜欢苹果、香蕉之类的水果。
I like fruit such as apples and bananas.
他每天看电视、玩游戏之类的，不爱学习。
He watches TV, plays games and so on every day; he doesn't like studying.
use: Comes after a list: A、B之类(的).

ex: 他是一名临床医生。
He is a clinical doctor.
这种新药还在做临床试验。
This new drug is still in clinical trials.
use: Medical word: 临床医学 "clinical medicine".

ex: 请在三天之内完成。
Please finish within three days.
学校之内禁止吸烟。
Smoking is forbidden on school grounds.
use: After time or place words; same as 以内. Opposite 之外.

ex: 我们在学校正门见吧。
Let's meet at the school's main gate.
博物馆的正门在修，请走侧门。
The museum's main entrance is under repair; please use the side door.
use: Opposite: 后门 "back door", 侧门 "side door".

ex: 这个国家有很多政党。
This country has many political parties.
两个政党在选举中竞争很激烈。
The two parties competed fiercely in the election.
use: Measure word 个. 党 alone often means the Communist Party in China.

ex: 他在外交部任职。
He holds a post at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
她在这家公司任职已经十年了。
She has worked at this company for ten years.
use: Formal; pattern 在…任职.

m: A **mark** the **finger** points at: a **target** or **index**.
ex: 今年的生产指标已经完成了。
This year's production target has been met.
医生说我的各项指标都正常。
The doctor says all my readings are normal.
use: Used for quotas and for medical test results.

ex: 中国有悠久的历史。
China has a long history.
这所大学有着悠久的传统。
This university has a long tradition.
use: Only for history, culture and tradition, not for physical length.

m: A **meeting** of those who **supervise** **matters**: a **board of directors**.
ex: 董事会明天开会。
The board meets tomorrow.
这个决定需要董事会同意。
This decision needs the board's approval.
use: 董事长 is "chairman of the board".

ex: 我家离市区不远。
My home isn't far from the city centre.
周末市区的交通特别拥挤。
At weekends traffic downtown is very heavy.
use: Opposite: 郊区 "suburbs".

ex: 我爸爸是老师。
My dad is a teacher.
爸爸每天早上送我去学校。
Dad takes me to school every morning.
use: Spoken; 父亲 is formal.

ex: 敌人的兵力比我们多。
The enemy has more troops than we do.
他们集中兵力攻打这座城市。
They concentrated their forces to attack the city.
use: Military; refers to the number of troops.

m: The **general** **value** of what is **produced**: **gross output value**.
ex: 今年全省的工业总产值增加了。
The province's gross industrial output rose this year.
农业总产值比去年高了百分之五。
Gross agricultural output is five percent higher than last year.
use: Statistics word in reports and news.

m: Rays shoot out like **spokes** of a wheel, **shooting** outward: **radiation**.
ex: 手机辐射对人体有害吗？
Is radiation from mobile phones harmful?
这个城市的发展辐射到了周边地区。
This city's growth has spread out to the surrounding areas.
use: Also figurative "spread out from a centre".

ex: 我每个月买一本杂志。
I buy a magazine every month.
这本杂志上有很多好看的图片。
This magazine has lots of nice pictures.
use: Measure word 本 or 期 (an issue).

ex: 他们确立了新的目标。
They set new goals.
这次会议确立了公司未来的发展方向。
This meeting established the company's future direction.
use: Formal; with 目标, 关系, 地位, 制度.

m: **Light** and **beginnings**: **Guangxu**, reign name of the second-last Qing emperor.
ex: 光绪皇帝想进行改革。
The Guangxu Emperor wanted to carry out reforms.
这座楼建于光绪年间。
This building was built in the Guangxu era.
use: Reign 1875–1908; linked with the Hundred Days' Reform.

m: The **general** who **supervises** several provinces: a **governor-general** or **viceroy**.
ex: 他当过两江总督。
He served as Viceroy of Liangjiang.
清朝的总督管理一个或几个省。
A Qing governor-general ran one or more provinces.
use: Historical title.

m: The **magnificent** land in the **middle**: **China**, the Chinese nation.
ex: 我们都是中华儿女。
We are all sons and daughters of China.
中华文化有几千年的历史。
Chinese culture has a history of several thousand years.
use: Cultural, formal name: 中华人民共和国, 中华民族.

m: **Defend** what you **leave** in place: to **keep** or **retain**.
ex: 这座老房子保留得很好。
This old house has been well preserved.
我保留自己的意见。
I reserve my own opinion.
use: For keeping things as they are; 保存 is "store, preserve".

ex: 明天有一个英语测试。
There's an English test tomorrow.
新软件要先测试一下才能用。
New software has to be tested before it can be used.
use: Used for skills and machines; 考试 is a school exam.

ex: 他工作效率很高。
He works very efficiently.
用电脑可以大大提高效率。
Using a computer can greatly improve efficiency.
use: Goes with 高/低 and 提高.

ex: 客人们相继离开了。
The guests left one after another.
这几年，很多新工厂相继建成。
In recent years, many new factories have been built one after another.
use: Written; in speech 先后 or 一个接一个.

ex: 这是我的私人问题。
This is my private matter.
他开了一家私人医院。
He opened a private hospital.
use: 私人 before a noun: 私人生活, 私人飞机.

ex: 路很滑，小心点儿！
The road is slippery, be careful!
他小心地把杯子放在桌子上。
He carefully put the cup on the table.
use: 小心 + thing = "watch out for": 小心车.

ex: 明天局部地区有雨。
Tomorrow there will be rain in some areas.
这只是局部问题，不影响整体。
This is only a local problem; it doesn't affect the whole.
use: Opposite: 整体 / 全部 "whole".

m: **Change** the old **hide**: to **transform**, a big change.
ex: 社会正在发生巨大的变革。
Society is going through huge changes.
这项技术给教育带来了变革。
This technology has transformed education.
use: Bigger and deeper than 变化; close to 改革.

ex: 他背着沉重的行李。
He carried heavy luggage.
听到这个消息，大家心情都很沉重。
Everyone felt heavy-hearted at the news.
use: Often figurative: 沉重的负担 "heavy burden".

ex: 这个城市有很多景点。
This city has many tourist sights.
长城是北京最有名的景点之一。
The Great Wall is one of Beijing's most famous sights.
use: Measure word 个. 景区 is a larger scenic area.

ex: 老师找他谈话了。
The teacher had a talk with him.
我们的谈话被电话打断了。
Our conversation was interrupted by a phone call.
use: Often a serious talk: 和某人谈话.

m: **Heaven** and **grand**: **Qianlong**, reign name of a long-ruling Qing emperor.
ex: 乾隆是清朝很有名的皇帝。
Qianlong was a famous Qing emperor.
乾隆皇帝曾经六次去江南。
The Qianlong Emperor visited the south six times.
use: Reign 1736–1795; 乾 here is qián, not gān.

ex: 这张桌子用的是好木材。
This table is made of good wood.
这个地区出产大量木材。
This region produces a lot of timber.
use: Material word; 木头 is everyday "wood".

ex: 请写上你所属的单位。
Please write down the organisation you belong to.
这家公司和它所属的工厂都在上海。
The company and its factories are all in Shanghai.
use: Formal; before a noun: 所属部门.

ex: 当前最重要的是安全。
The most important thing right now is safety.
当前的经济形势比较好。
The current economic situation is fairly good.
use: Formal; 目前 and 现在 are close.

ex: 对困难学生，学校会予以帮助。
The school will help students in difficulty.
对违反规定的人，公司将予以处罚。
The company will punish those who break the rules.
use: Very formal; followed by a two-character verb: 予以支持, 予以批评.

ex: 这件衣服你穿很合适。
This outfit suits you well.
我们找个合适的时间再谈吧。
Let's find a suitable time to talk again.
use: Adjective; 适合 is the verb: 这件衣服适合你.

ex: 我只是开玩笑，你别当真。
I'm only joking; don't take it seriously.
他说的话你当真相信吗？
Do you really believe what he said?
use: 别当真 "don't take it seriously" is very common.

ex: 军队镇压了这次起义。
The army put down the uprising.
政府派兵去镇压反抗。
The government sent troops to suppress the revolt.
use: Political and historical; used with 起义, 反抗.

ex: 音乐是这部电影的灵魂。
Music is the soul of this film.
很多人相信人死后灵魂还在。
Many people believe the soul lives on after death.
use: Also means the core of something: 灵魂人物 "key figure".

ex: 这家公司在快速扩张。
This company is expanding fast.
历史上很多国家都想扩张领土。
In history many countries wanted to expand their territory.
use: Often for territory, power or business; 扩大 is more neutral.

ex: 这个组织后来分裂了。
This organisation later split up.
细胞分裂是生命的基本过程。
Cell division is a basic process of life.
use: For groups and countries; opposite 统一 "unify".

m: A **hand** **chosen** to compete: a **contestant** or athlete.
ex: 这位选手跑得非常快。
This athlete runs very fast.
比赛一共有二十名选手参加。
Twenty contestants took part in the competition.
use: Measure word 名 or 位. 运动员 is "athlete" in general.

ex: 他相信社会主义。
He believes in socialism.
你不能只考虑自己，这是个人主义。
You can't think only of yourself; that's individualism.
use: Suffix-like: 社会主义, 浪漫主义 "romanticism".

ex: 你别生气，我不是故意的。
Don't be angry; I didn't mean it.
他很生气，一整天都没跟我说话。
He was angry and didn't speak to me all day.
use: 生某人的气 "be angry with someone". Can also mean "vitality".

m: **River**, **pool**, **people**: **Jiang Zemin**, a former president of China.
ex: 江泽民曾经是中国的国家主席。
Jiang Zemin was once China's president.
江泽民出生在江苏扬州。
Jiang Zemin was born in Yangzhou, Jiangsu.
use: President of the PRC 1993–2003.

ex: 将士们在前线英勇作战。
The officers and men fought bravely at the front.
皇帝亲自出城迎接回来的将士。
The emperor went out of the city himself to greet the returning troops.
use: Literary; mostly in history and stories.

m: Put **out** to **sell**: to **sell**, offer for sale.
ex: 这套房子正在出售。
This flat is for sale.
商店门口写着“本店出售新鲜水果”。
The sign at the shop door says "Fresh fruit sold here".
use: Formal and written; in speech use 卖.

m: The **knot** tied at the end of an **argument**: a **conclusion**.
ex: 你的结论是什么？
What's your conclusion?
现在下结论还太早。
It's too early to draw a conclusion now.
use: 下结论 / 得出结论 "draw a conclusion".

ex: 这个城市人口密度很大。
This city has a very high population density.
水的密度比油大，所以油会浮在上面。
Water is denser than oil, so oil floats on top.
use: 人口密度 "population density".

ex: 我忘记带钥匙了。
I forgot to bring my keys.
我永远不会忘记那一天。
I will never forget that day.
use: Same as 忘; 忘记 is a little more formal.

m: **Cao** (surname) and **grasp**: **Cao Cao**, a warlord of the Three Kingdoms period.
ex: 曹操是三国时期的人物。
Cao Cao was a figure of the Three Kingdoms period.
中国有句话：“说曹操，曹操到。”
There's a Chinese saying: "Speak of Cao Cao, and Cao Cao arrives."
use: 说曹操曹操到 is the Chinese "speak of the devil".

ex: 火车在轨道上飞快地前进。
The train sped along the track.
这颗卫星已经进入了轨道。
This satellite has entered orbit.
use: Also "on track": 工作走上了轨道.

ex: 他们是一对好朋友。
They are a pair of good friends.
公园里有一对老夫妻在散步。
An old couple is taking a walk in the park.
use: Followed by a noun: 一对耳环, 一对夫妻.

ex: 天上有无数的星星。
There are countless stars in the sky.
为了这个梦想，他失败了无数次。
He failed countless times for the sake of this dream.
use: Often 无数次 "countless times".

ex: 每个人都是独立的个体。
Every person is an independent individual.
他开了一家小饭馆，当了个体户。
He opened a small restaurant and became self-employed.
use: 个体户 "self-employed small business owner".

ex: 我姑姑住在上海。
My aunt lives in Shanghai.
姑姑每年春节都给我们带礼物。
My aunt brings us presents every Spring Festival.
use: Only father's sister; mother's sister is 阿姨 or 姨妈.

ex: 他下决心戒烟。
He made up his mind to quit smoking.
只要有决心，就没有做不到的事。
With determination, there's nothing you can't do.
use: 下决心 "make up one's mind".

m: A **hand** at a **high** level: an **expert**, a master.
ex: 他是下棋的高手。
He's an expert at chess.
没想到你做饭也是个高手！
I didn't expect you to be a great cook too!
use: Spoken and friendly; 专家 is "expert" in a field of study.

ex: 草原上有很多牛和羊。
There are many cows and sheep on the grassland.
夏天我们去内蒙古看大草原。
In summer we went to Inner Mongolia to see the vast grasslands.
use: Measure word 片.

m: **Go out** and **enter**: to **come and go**, also a discrepancy.
ex: 出入请随手关门。
Please close the door behind you when coming in or out.
他说的和事实有一些出入。
What he said differs somewhat from the facts.
use: 有出入 "doesn't quite match".

ex: 这里手机没有信号。
There's no phone signal here.
红灯是停车的信号。
A red light is the signal to stop.
use: Common with phones: 信号不好 "bad reception".

ex: 他踢球时受伤了。
He got hurt playing football.
还好车里的人都没有受伤。
Luckily nobody in the car was hurt.
use: Intransitive: 他受伤了. To hurt someone is 伤害.

ex: 马克思写了很多关于无产阶级的文章。
Marx wrote many articles about the proletariat.
无产阶级是工人阶级的另一种说法。
The proletariat is another term for the working class.
use: Political term; opposite 资产阶级 "bourgeoisie".

ex: 他的品德很好。
He has good moral character.
学校不仅要教知识，也要培养学生的品德。
Schools must not only teach knowledge but also build students' character.
use: Formal; close to 道德 "morality".

m: The **owner** of a **teaching**: the **leader of a religion or sect**.
ex: 他是这个教派的教主。
He is the leader of this sect.
小说里的教主武功很高。
The sect leader in the novel has great martial skill.
use: Common in martial arts novels; also playful for a trendsetter.

ex: 请再说一遍。
Please say it again.
这本书我从头到尾看了一遍。
I read this book once from start to finish.
use: 遍 counts actions done from start to finish; 次 just counts times.

ex: 他伸出手和我握手。
He held out his hand to shake mine.
朋友有困难时，我们要伸出援手。
When friends are in trouble, we should lend a helping hand.
use: 伸出援手 "lend a helping hand".

m: An **old** **grandpa** of the house: **master** or lord.
ex: 老爷，客人到了。
Master, the guests have arrived.
电视剧里的老爷总是很严肃。
The master in TV dramas is always very stern.
use: Old-fashioned. 老爷爷 is a different, friendly word for an old man.

ex: 最近菜价上涨了。
Vegetable prices have gone up recently.
下了几天雨，河水上涨了不少。
After several days of rain, the river rose quite a lot.
use: For prices and water levels; opposite 下跌.

ex: 中华人民共和国成立于一九四九年。
The People's Republic of China was founded in 1949.
法国是一个共和国。
France is a republic.
use: Part of many country names: 中华人民共和国.

ex: 我们去机场迎接客人。
We went to the airport to meet the guests.
全家人都在准备迎接新年。
The whole family is getting ready to welcome the New Year.
use: For people and for events: 迎接挑战 "meet a challenge".

ex: 我们应该尊重老人。
We should respect the elderly.
我尊重你的选择。
I respect your choice.
use: Also a noun: 互相尊重 "mutual respect".

ex: 我帮你安装这个软件。
I'll help you install this software.
工人明天来给我们安装空调。
The workers are coming tomorrow to install our air conditioner.
use: For software, machines and fittings.

ex: 政府决心打击腐败。
The government is determined to fight corruption.
这个官员因为腐败被抓了。
This official was arrested for corruption.
use: Mostly political; for food going bad use 变质 or 坏了.

m: **Draw** something to **come in**: to **introduce** from outside.
ex: 公司引进了新技术。
The company brought in new technology.
这个城市引进了很多人才。
This city has attracted many talented people.
use: For technology, equipment, talent, foreign investment.

ex: 不论多忙，他都会给家里打电话。
No matter how busy he is, he phones home.
不论天气好坏，比赛都照常进行。
The match will go ahead whatever the weather.
use: Pattern 不论…都…; same as 无论 and 不管.

ex: 你一定要把握这个机会。
You must seize this chance.
这次比赛我没有把握能赢。
I'm not sure I can win this match.
use: 有把握 "be sure"; 把握机会 "seize an opportunity".

ex: 老师鼓励我多说汉语。
The teacher encourages me to speak more Chinese.
谢谢你一直以来的鼓励和支持。
Thank you for all your encouragement and support.
use: Pattern 鼓励某人做某事.

ex: 人群中有人在叫我的名字。
Someone in the crowd was calling my name.
看到警察，人群慢慢散开了。
When they saw the police, the crowd slowly broke up.
use: Also "group of people" in a social sense: 老年人群.

ex: 我在网上搜索了这个词。
I searched for this word online.
警察正在山里搜索那个失踪的孩子。
The police are searching the hills for the missing child.
use: Common for the internet: 搜索引擎 "search engine".
